title: PXAPI artifact descriptor v1
description: The metadata of one stored artifact of an Analysis Run: identity, type, digest, size, content type, visibility and creation time (Confluence 40239107 §6). Where the bytes live — object key, bucket, path — is deliberately not part of this contract; that is persistence data owned by A5 and keyed by artifact_id. Visibility is what application authorisation decides on: an object key alone never grants customer or internal access.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this artifact belongs to.

artifact_id.description: Required. The stable identity of the artifact; artifact_ref values point at it.

artifact_type.description: Required. The producer-defined artifact type. Contract names are the usual values for contract documents; rendered reports, raw provider payloads and chart data have their own types.

name.description: Required. The contract the document validates against.

schema_version.description: Required. The contract version the document claims.

contract.description: Required, nullable. Which contract the artifact is a document of; null if and only if the artifact is not a contract document (e.g. a rendered PDF, a raw provider payload, chart data).

content_type.description: Required. The media type of the stored bytes, lowercase, e.g. application/json or application/pdf.

size_bytes.description: Required. The size of the stored bytes.

algorithm.description: Required. The digest algorithm, e.g. sha256.

value.description: Required. The lowercase hexadecimal digest of the stored bytes.

digest.description: Required. The content digest, so that a delivered artifact can be bound to exactly one run and one set of bytes.

visibility.description: Required. Whether the artifact may reach a customer (CUSTOMER) or is Pixelkiez-internal only (INTERNAL). Internal analysis documents are never CUSTOMER.

created_at.description: Required. When the artifact was stored.
